barriers.statement: The bank does not yet know why the rest of the dormant cardholders have stopped using their card.

converters.shape: Nobody at the bank can currently say which dormant cardholders eventually start transacting again on their own, or what distinguishes them.

candidates.segment: Cards that have only just crossed the 90-day dormancy line
candidates.restsOn: how recently the last transaction happened relative to the 90-day cutoff
candidates.why: a card that went quiet last week may just need a timely nudge, while one quiet for a year may need a different approach entirely

candidates.segment: Cards with a standing instruction or auto-debit still linked to them
candidates.restsOn: whether a recurring payment is attached to the card
candidates.why: a card with an auto-debit may show intermittent, not full, dormancy and could respond to a different message than one with no linked payment at all
